title: Blend Tree Locomotion
description: Replace the separate walk/run states with a single Blend Tree that smoothly blends idle, walk, and run based on Speed.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Create a smooth locomotion system with a single Blend Tree.

1. Open the PlayerAnim controller from Task2 (or create a new one).
2. Remove the Walk and Run states, keep Idle as a fallback or replace with a Blend Tree.
3. Create a new state: right‑click → Create State → From New Blend Tree. Name it "Locomotion".
4. Double‑click the Blend Tree to edit it. In the Inspector, set Blend Type to 1D, Parameter to Speed (create if needed).
5. Add three motion fields: drag Idle clip into first, Walk clip into second, Run into third.
6. Set thresholds: Idle = 0, Walk = 2, Run = 5.
7. Make the Blend Tree the default state (Entry → Locomotion).
8. Test: as you move, the animations blend smoothly. At speed 1.5, it mixes Idle and Walk; at 3.5, Walk and Run.
9. Use the same script from Task2; it sets Speed parameter.

Take a screenshot of the Blend Tree inspector showing motion fields and thresholds, and the Animator window with the Blend Tree state.
hints: If you don't have an Idle clip, you can create a static clip or use a copy of the Walk clip with speed=0.
Make sure the Speed parameter is the one used in the controller.
expectedOutput: Smooth transitions between idle, walk, run based on velocity.
